stem: Meena's family lives in Pune. Her science teacher asks the class to suggest one action that will help save fossil fuels and to explain why it helps. Which action and reason are correct?

options.text: Meena's father should drive the car to office alone every day because a car is faster than a bus.
Meena's brother should cycle to school because cycling does not burn petrol or diesel, so less fossil fuel is used.
Meena's mother should keep the gas stove burning on high flame even after cooking, because LPG never runs out.
Meena should switch on all the lights and fans at home because electricity is free and unlimited.

teacher.key_rationale: B correctly pairs a fossil-fuel-saving action (cycling) with the correct reason (no petrol or diesel is burned). A increases fuel use despite the speed benefit, C wastes LPG and wrongly claims it is unlimited, and D wrongly assumes electricity is unlimited and ignores that much of it is generated from coal.
